posts.text:
I’m honored to receive the endorsement of Florida’s largest and most influential business advocacy organization, the Florida Chamber of Commerce. 

I’m committed to making life more affordable by keeping taxes low, reducing burdensome regulations and litigation, and diversifying our economy. 

As Governor, I look forward to working again with the Florida Chamber to create more high-paying jobs for Floridians and further Florida’s reputation as the best state in the country for business.
